name: The Usufruct License
licenseTextNote: LICENSE.txt is the reference text: Seat-Limited with every optional provision included and every fill left as a bracketed placeholder. Generated by the command in referenceCommand.
referenceCommand: generate.sh -y '[YEAR]' -c '[COPYRIGHT HOLDER]' -p '[PROJECT NAME]' -s seat-limited -t '[THRESHOLD]' --seat-definition '[SEAT DEFINITION]' --lookback-years '[LOOKBACK YEARS]' --usage-statement --provenance-marks --require-acceptance

seatDefinition.summary: The Licensor defines a seat in the Operational Scope line, including by headcount of people in named roles at the licensee's organization, counted whether or not each person runs the Software.

useBeyondThreshold.summary: Production use beyond the free threshold without a paid license is owed at the Licensor's published price for each period of use, looking back a stated number of years. No penalty or multiplier.

usageStatement.summary: On written request, at most once a year, a licensee above the free threshold states its seats and period of use. Never requires disclosure of data the Software processed.

provenanceMarks.summary: The Software marks its outputs as coming from the Software and showing the license state (licensed or evaluation). Marks identify no person or organization and do not alter substantive content; removing, altering or forging them is not permitted.

acceptance.summary: The Software may require an affirmative act accepting the license before first use; use is acceptance either way.

optionalProvisionsNote: Each optional provision is included whole or left out whole (Section 2C). Omitting a flag omits the provision.

unconditional.summary: Free use at any scale, including operating a service, with no further condition.

no-competing-service.summary: Free use except operating the Software, or a fork of it, as a service competing with the Licensor's own offering.

no-third-party-hosting.summary: Free use except providing the Software to third parties as a hosted or managed service.

noncommercial.summary: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires a separate license.

seat-limited.summary: Free in production up to a stated seat/device/user threshold; unlimited free non-production use.

2.2.note: Frozen. Byte-identical to the text released as 2.2 (Section 2C); never edited. Projects that adopted 2.2 remain on it unless they adopt 2.3 in full.
